title: Guards — Where an Injection Sits, Versus How It Is Hidden
note: These answer different questions about the same turn, which is why a reader conflates them. The quoted-content label names WHERE the attack sits: inside material the agent was asked to process, so the instruction arrives wearing the costume of data. The obfuscation label names HOW it is concealed: the encoding or rendering hides it from inspection. A concealed instruction inside quoted material trips both, and obfuscation wins — concealment is detectable BEFORE the payload is understood, and holding early is the entire point of a channel guard. The quoted-content finding stays true and belongs in the diagnostic; it is the emitted label that must be the one a verifier can act on soonest.
